title: Scraping targets that no longer exist (reference)
description:
Source items 1 and 2 (Boston University's facts/stats page as JSON, and a table extracted from the UCI Machine Learning Repository's datasets page) both target real pages - checked directly rather than assumed dead:

- BU's facts/stats page (bu.edu/president/boston-university-facts-stats/) loads successfully but no longer contains a single `<table>` element anywhere in its HTML - the page has been redesigned since the source repo was written, into a layout of individual stat widgets instead of a table.
- The UCI ML Repository's datasets page (archive.ics.uci.edu/ml/datasets.php) now loads as a client-rendered single-page app - its raw HTML has no `<table>` either, since the dataset list is fetched and rendered by JavaScript after the page loads, which `requests` + BeautifulSoup can't execute.

Neither is a real scraping target anymore, static or otherwise - see 30days-d22-01 for a real, still-working scraping exercise (Wikipedia's presidents table) using the same tools (BeautifulSoup) this day is actually about.
